changes: Colour plugin: an opt-in ambient white point (the ambient-white-point-enabled key, off by default) that follows the ambient light sensor's colour temperature through Mutter's Night Light, the same patch as alarm-aurora's gnome-settings-daemon-aurora and fedora-aurora's gnome-settings-daemon.
notes: alarm-aurora's patch without its last hunk, which only creates an empty subprojects/.wraplock (a Meson by-product). It applies unchanged to 51.0, which already names the compile-schemas target compiled_schemas (fedora-aurora's 50.1 patch adds that). alarm-aurora's dependency on aurora-keep-config is not carried: dpkg keeps edited conffiles itself.
